nodes.title: 六层架构
nodes.summary: Describes a six-layer architecture detailing each layer’s component and completion status: the arbitration layer with the TrustFactor+Arbitration module completed on 2026-03-18, collaborative layer modules doc_collab.py and squad_lead.py already done, observation layer metrics_collector.py completed on 2026-03-18 for cost/quality aggregation, communication layer using existing A2A Redis Streams, lifecycle involving omc_patches P0+P1 done, archival layer transitioning MemoV snap() to event_log finished, and metabolic layer gc_policy.py finalized on 2026-03-18 for evolution and garbage collection.

nodes.title: 检索栈决策
nodes.summary:
## 检索栈决策

```
GitNexus (Neo4j)     — 关系：调用链/影响分析（不可替代）
PageIndex (树索引)   — 定位：代码/文档导航（替代 OpenViking 代码场景）
event_log (JSONL)    — 时序：审计/操作历史（替代 MemoV）
auto-memory (MD)     — 锚点：高频知识（保留）
OpenViking (向量)    — 降级：仅非结构化文本（会议纪要等）
MemoV (SQLite)       — 砍：snap() 降级为 event_log 3行 wrapper
```

nodes.title: R2 — OpenClaw 注入（研究+实现 已完成）
nodes.summary:
## R2 — OpenClaw 注入（研究+实现 已完成）

ClawTeam 用 **命令无关的 CLI 模式**，非传统插件系统：
- **Env 注入**: `CLAW_AGENT_*` 环境变量传递身份
- **Prompt 注入**: OpenClaw 用 `-p` flag，Claude 用 tmux buffer
- **Exit hook**: shell `;` 追加清理命令
- **无 manifest**: spawn 时自动注册到 team
- 实现: `spawn_integration.py`，支持 Claude/Codex/Gemini/OpenClaw + 任意 CLI

nodes.title: claw-grid 治理层资产（可复用）
nodes.prefix_summary: The document outlines reusable governance-layer assets from the “claw-grid” project, listing key TypeScript modules, their sizes, reuse percentages, and target Python counterparts—mostly mapping trust-factor, arbitration, policy engine, cost control, quality judge, evolution, and audit logging logic to corresponding `omc_patches` modules such as `sovereign_arbiter.py`, `metrics_collector.py`, and `gc_policy.py`. It also notes the migration approach (TypeScript to Python) and allows optional Redis usage with default filesystem storage.

nodes.title: 2026-03-18 完成的治理层
nodes.summary: The document outlines key components of a governance system finalized on 2026-03-18. It summarizes four modules: `sovereign_arbiter.py` (approximately 260 lines) which manages GaaS trust scoring (0–100), includes cooling mechanisms, and supports risk-level voting (low/med/high/critical); `metrics_collector.py` (~280 lines) implementing a five-tier model degradation process with three quality gates (40+30+30) and aggregation from Worker to Squad to Sovereign; `gc_policy.py` (~290 lines) handling strategy evolution modes (balanced/innovate/harden/repair/auto), Shannon anti-convergence, and log rotation; and `memov_compat.py` (~25 lines) providing a `snap()` to event-log JSONL wrapper.

nodes.title: 2026-03-18 额外完成
nodes.summary: Outline of additional tasks on 2026‑03‑18: introduced `agent_selection.py` DTO to isolate Evolution/TrustFactor/CostController, performed code-standard refactors (Strategy enums, unified GCResult returns, explicit `auto_evaluate` param, atomic JSONL handling, exception isolation), enhanced `/codex` (stdin exec, review uncommitted) and `/gemini` commands (`@file` injection, screenshot-to-code, large-context research), created CCG synthesis artifact (Claude fallback), downgraded MemoV via `memov_compat.py` snap→event_log, and issued omc-ask feedback forbidding `$()` expansion in file prompts.
